entities.name: No-Fault Divorce
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: California's Family Law Act (1969) introduced no-fault divorce — ending the requirement to prove adultery, cruelty, or abandonment. (Soviet Russia had it since 1917.) By 2010, no-fault divorce was available in all 50 US states and most Western countries. England finally adopted it in 2022.
